numAi brings modern LLMs (ChatGPT, DeepSeek, Gemini and more) to your old Android device.

To start, you'll need an API key. This app will guide you through the process. All you need is a modern smartphone or PC.

Hit Next to continue!
An error happened. Check your API key and try again.
In some Android 2.x UIs, a ToggleButton may be taller than a regular button, causing the interface to look slightly uneven. This option attempts to fix this issue.
API key changed; please press OK and return to Settings menu before choosing models

Failed to send message:
%s

For image perception support, change the model to Gemma, Gemini, Qwen, GPT or Kimi!

Note: even if the models are successfully retrieved on the next screen, this does not mean that you have definitely entered the key correctly. If you have entered the key incorrectly, you will see a corresponding error in the chat interface.

Android 1.6+. For Android <3.0, Wolfius is required: github.com/gohoski/Wolfius

1. On a modern browser, go to voidai.app/register and create an account.
If you use Gmail, enter your email without the dots before @gmail.com.
2. After logging in, navigate to the API Keys section in your dashboard.
3. Click Generate New API Key.
4. Copy the key that appears and transfer it to your device using one of these methods:

This API supports Android 1.0+ out of the box, but provides very few free models.

1. On a modern browser, go to signin.ollama.com/sign-up and create an account.
2. After logging in, go to Settings > Keys.
3. Click Add API Key, then Generate API Key.
4. Copy the key that appears and transfer it to your device using one of these methods:

Android 1.6+. For Android <4.4, it is required to setup Wolfius for connectivity: github.com/gohoski/Wolfius

1. On a modern browser, go to opencode.ai/auth and create an account.
2. After logging in, navigate to the API Keys section in your dashboard.
3. Click Create API Key and enter any key name.
4. Copy the key that appears and transfer it to your device using one of these methods:

Method 1: File transfer
• Create a text file with only the API key and save it.
• Transfer the file to your phone via USB, Bluetooth or similar.
• You will be able to import the key from the file on the next screen.

Method 2: adb
• On the next screen, press on the text input box, and paste the key using this command:
adb shell input text "API KEY"
